deadline.value: Apply by January 5, 2027 (11:59 pm Pacific) for autumn 2027 entry.
deadline.quote: Application deadline: January 5, 2027 | The department accepts new Ph.D. students for autumn quarter only. Completed applications must be submitted by 11:59 pm (Pacific Time) on the deadline date.

gre_general.value: GRE scores may be submitted but are not required and are only looked at if the committee cannot decide otherwise.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores may be submitted, but they are not required. | The admissions committee will only review GRE scores if they cannot make a decision based on the required documents.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE applies to materials science.

toefl_min.value: If a test is needed, MSE expects TOEFL 92, Duolingo 120 or IELTS 7.0.
toefl_min.quote: If an exam is required, applicants must meet the recommended test scores of 92 TOEFL, 120 DUO, or 7.0 IELTS for consideration.

ielts_min.value: If a test is needed, MSE expects IELTS 7.0.
ielts_min.quote: If an exam is required, applicants must meet the recommended test scores of 92 TOEFL, 120 DUO, or 7.0 IELTS for consideration.

english_waiver.value: The test is waived after at least 3 years of degree study taught entirely in English (Graduate School documentation rules still apply).
english_waiver.quote: This exam is waived if previous degree was earned in the US, or at least 3 years of degree completion with all instruction in English.

supervisor.value: You name 1-3 professors of interest in the application and shortlisted applicants meet faculty in February; no rule on prior supervisor agreement is stated.
supervisor.quote: Within the application, you will indicate 1-3 professors who are of interest to you. | A select group of applicants will be contacted by early February for individual meetings with faculty.

funding.value: The admissions pages do not state whether all PhD students are funded.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's in MSE or a related field (engineering, physics, chemistry) is accepted.
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate or master's degree in materials science and engineering, or in a relevant field of study such as another engineering major, physics or chemistry, is required.

notes: TAs are only offered to international students meeting extra English conditions (Graduate School Policy 5.2).
